item.title: 2026 Dog Licenses
item.description: 2026 Dog licenses are available at the Town Clerk's Office. The last day to register your dog without a late fee is February 28, 2026. Late fees are $25.00 PER dog. Dogs may be licensed by mail, in person or on- line. Payments made in person at the Town Clerk’s Office are cash and check only.
